newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Flood disaster area declared in Australia.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Flood disaster area declared in Australia.

text.p: The Australian state of Queensland said on Tuesday a flood disaster area had been declared for large areas of central Queensland after heavy rain brought on by tropical cyclones.
"This declaration takes the financial pressure off local councils who cannot be expected to foot the bil for flood repairs," state emergency services minister Mick Veiver said in a statement.
Veivers said the impact of flood waters were still being felt in areas of central Queensland with initial estimates of damage reaching more than A$2 million.

Veivers said rain was continuing and reports from Mount Isa and Cloncurry indicated flood waters might reach similar peak levels to those which led to more than 100 people being evacuated at the weekend and on Monday.

The Leichardt River at Mt Isa is at its highest level for 10 years as rain from a tropical cyclonic low continues. More than 100 people have been evacuated from their homes around the town of Cloncurry.
MIM Holdings Ltd said both road and rail links from MIM's Mt Isa operations to Cloncurry remained cut.
"It is my understanding both road and rail links from Mt Isa to Cloncurry are cut," MIM's public affairs manager Colin Myers told Reuters.
Transport of MIM's lead, zinc and copper products were halted on Monday because of the rail link being affected by flood waters.
